final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro is a local AI trading desk with cockpit UI, live sentiment telemetry, market data, Bob, committee, guardrails, broker paper integration, and learning loop.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 and supervised operators validating Bob before real-money escalation.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open cockpit on http://127.0.0.1:8002, inspect Genie/Deep/chart/broker, click or submit a ticker mandate, let Bob/CASE run evidence before verdict/execution, then record journal/feedback.
final_objective.proof_output: API /health returns 200, /sentiment/pulse returns news-backed pulses, and the served Genie JS no longer renders Reddit NO_DATA as the ticker-level data state.

what_was_done: Diagnosed the screenshot: NO_DATA was the Reddit/social signal field, not the ticker-level sentiment data state.
Verified live /sentiment/pulse examples where tickers had news articles, multiple sources, score, confidence, and analyst_score while reddit.signal was NO_DATA.
Updated frontend/js/genie-panel.js with pulseSignalLabel so cards show NEWS <count> when news exists and SOCIAL -- only when social is empty.
Updated the Bob TICKER command to include Noticias=<count> and NewsLabel=<label> so Bob does not interpret Reddit=0 as no data.
Added frontend contract assertions preventing the old ambiguous reddit.signal || NO_DATA rendering from coming back.
Left IBKR/broker files untouched because another agent is working there.

live_runtime: /sentiment/pulse showed USIO/DIBS/INOD etc with scores, confidence, sources, news.articles, and reddit.signal=NO_DATA.
Served /js/genie-panel.js contains function pulseSignalLabel and Noticias=, and no longer contains esc(reddit.signal || "NO_DATA").
tests: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; python -m pytest tests\test_api_routes_sync.py::test_frontend_genie_pulse_click_drives_bob_and_chart tests\test_sentiment_live_monitor.py tests\test_watchlist_pulse.py tests\test_sentiment_curator.py tests\test_sentiment_endpoints.py -q => 20 passed
python scripts\browser_smoke.py --skip-chat --timeout-ms 180000 => ok true, chart_fetch ok, canvas nonblank, console_errors []

risks: Some backend source labels can still be NO_DATA even when article counts exist; the UI now avoids presenting that as total absence of data.
NewsAPI quota can still be exhausted during per-ticker collection, but this issue was not the cause of the screenshot label.
next_step: Add explicit per-source health chips in the Genie card if Marco wants to see NewsAPI/Finnhub/NewsScout/Reddit status separately instead of one compact signal label.
